description: MainActivity.kt is the primary source file for an Android Tic-Tac-Toe game implementing game logic, UI interactions, and animations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages game state, UI updates, and user interactions for the Tic-Tac-Toe game.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, loads scores, and attaches button listeners.

methods.name: loadScores
methods.description: Loads game scores and preferences from persistent storage.

methods.name: saveScores
methods.description: Saves current game scores and player choice to preferences.

methods.name: setupBoardUI
methods.description: Initializes the game board UI and sets click listeners for each cell.

methods.name: getCellButton
methods.description: Retrieves the Button view for a specific cell based on row and column indices.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Handles a player's move, updates game state, and checks for game end conditions.

methods.name: animateMove
methods.description: Animates a move on the UI, toggling the icon and adding a bounce effect.

methods.name: updateScoreUI
methods.description: Updates the score display in the UI.

methods.name: updateTurnUI
methods.description: Updates the display to indicate which player's turn it is.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner or a draw in the game.

methods.name: endGame
methods.description: Handles post-game UI updates and displays game result dialog.

methods.name: showRestartDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog before restarting the game.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game board and state to start a new game.

methods.name: showPlayerSelectionDialog
methods.description: Allows user to select their preferred marker (King or Queen).
